question: How many customers are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;

question: List the names of all music genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre;

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes? (Track length is stored in milliseconds, and 5 minutes is 300,000.)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000;

question: List the first and last names of all employees whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';

question: How many albums are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album;

question: How many customers are there in each country? Show the country and the count, sorted by count (highest first), then by country name.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, Country;

question: What is the total sales amount for each billing country, sorted from highest to lowest, then by country name?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total_sales DESC, BillingCountry;

question: What is the total of all invoices in the year 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2011-01-01';

question: How many tracks belong to each genre? Show the genre name and the count, sorted by count (highest first), then by genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC, g.Name;

question: What are the names and lengths (in milliseconds) of the 5 longest tracks? If lengths tie, sort by name.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC, Name LIMIT 5;

question: Which artist has the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count FROM Artists ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY album_count DESC, ar.Name LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_invoice FROM Invoice;

question: List the first name, last name and country of all customers whose email ends with @gmail.com.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Country FROM Customer WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com';

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent? Show first name, last name and total spent.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.LastName, c.FirstName LIMIT 3;

question: What are the names of all customers who have bought at least one track from the 'Jazz' genre? Show each customer only once.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName;

question: Who are the top 3 artists by total revenue? Revenue is the sum of unit price × quantity from the invoice lines. Show the artist name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, ar.Name LIMIT 3;

question: What was the total sales amount for each month of the year 2011? Show the month as a two-digit number (01 to 12) and the total, in month order.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2011-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2012-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: What are the top 3 genres by total revenue? Show the genre name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC, g.Name LIMIT 3;

question: Which sales support agent (employee) is assigned to the most customers? Show their first name, last name and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY customer_count DESC, e.LastName, e.FirstName LIMIT 1;
